items.title: Quasi-compactness of a space is tested on its closed points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a space with the standing hypotheses is quasi-compact exactly when its set of closed points is (author lemma at source lines 2014-2018, label lemma-closed-points-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2020-2030) lifts a covering of the closed points to opens of the space, takes the complement of their union and uses that a nonempty such closed subset would contain a closed point (proof lines 2020-2029). The contradiction argument is the substance. H3.
